nodes.info: Wait until the opponent starts pressuring the teammate.
nodes.termination: The opponent is moving towards the teammate.

nodes.info: Move to either side of the opponent such that there is a clear angle of pass with the teammate.
nodes.termination: Coach is at either side of the opponent and there is a clear angle of pass with the teammate.

nodes.info: Receive or gain possession of the ball from the teammate.
nodes.termination: Stop when possession of the ball is secured.

nodes.info: Dribble the ball upwards to the goal while focusing on positioning for a potential pass and/or shot.
nodes.termination: Stop when there is an opportunity to shoot or if being pressured by the opponent.

nodes.info: Shoot the ball if in a good position to do so.
Make a through pass to teammate.

edges.condition: Opponent pressures (is moving towards) the teammate.
The Coach has possession of the ball.
There is an opportunity of goal.
The Coach is being pressured by opponent and there is an angle of pass between the coach and teammate.
